People expect each oracle config to deploy its own wrapper; the code skips deployment when a previous config already created a new-style wrapper for the same feed, so pairs such as USDC/USDbC share one wrapper.

People expect lowering FEE_MULTIPLIER from 4000 to 3000 to lower the protocol's fee share; the code sets liquidatorFeeBps to 3000, so the liquidator share falls to 30% and the protocol share rises to 70%.
